title_en: Character Riddles (19/20): Two Lines of Footprints in the Snow
note_en: 从 often marks a starting point, much like English "from": 从北京到上海 "from Beijing to Shanghai," 从一个地方走到另一个地方 "to walk from one place to another." The same 从 marks a start in time in words like 从小 "since childhood" and 从此 "from then on," and it always comes before the verb, with 到 often marking the endpoint.
